newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group cut to hold.

text.p: Barrington Research analyst Alexander Paris Jr said Tuesday he cut his rating on Apollo Group Inc to hold from buy on a valuation basis.

-- "Shares are up 57 percent since we raised our investment rating to 2-buy on April 4 and are trading at 59 (times) and 47 (times) our calendar 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates, representing a premium to the market, its competitors, and its long-term earnings growth rate of 25-30 percent," Paris said in a statement.
